AID TO ENABLE FACTORIES TO RESUME OPERATIONS

Most of the Chinese native goods factories
are finding it difficult to resume operations. With
a view to rendering them assistance, the Factory Resumption
Committee which was recently formed under the auspices
of the Shanghai Citizens' Native Goods Promotion Association
has inaugurated a "Native Goods Production Assistance
Group" with an office in Room 425, the Continental
Emporium Building, Nanking Road. Factories may apply
to the Group in question for registration and plans will
be formulated to enable them to resume business at an
early date. Factories are requested to send in
information on the following heads:-
1) What part of the machinery is located in safety areas?
2) Raw materials in stock.
3) Long-service workers.
4) The location of idle factories or unused land in
safety areas.
5) Goods in stock.
6) The persons who are willing to invest capital in any
factory.
7) The chances of acquiring land or factory premises.
8) Desire to rent or purchase machinery.
9) Lack of raw materials.
10) Lack of technical workers.
11) Means to dispose of goods.
12) Lack of cash capital.

（批：Special Report 29/11/37）

《民报》及其他本地报纸：1937年11月4日（下午）

援助工厂复工

大多数中国国货工厂发现难以恢复运营。为了向他们提供援助，最近在上海市民国货促进会主持下成立的工厂复工委员会，已在南京路大陆商场425室设立“国货生产援助组”。各工厂可向该组申请登记，并将制定计划以便它们早日恢复营业。请各工厂报送以下各项信息：
1) 机器的哪些部分位于安全区域？
2) 库存原材料。
3) 长期服务的工人。
4) 安全区域内闲置工厂或未使用土地的位置。
5) 库存货物。
6) 愿意向任何工厂投资资本的人员。
7) 获得土地或厂房的机会。
8) 租赁或购买机器的意愿。
9) 缺乏原材料。
10) 缺乏技术工人。
11) 货物处置渠道。
12) 缺乏现金资本。

（批注：特别报告 1937年11月29日）

of the Police for the registration of the committee would be

reached.

Subject Bureau of Social Affairs and Investigation of local factories.

Made by D.I. Kan Lien-pih Forwarded by C. Crawford

Attached is the translation of an investigation form
printed by the Bureau of Social Affairs and which will be
submitted to the Military Affairs Committee of the National
Government for examination.

Ostensibly these particulars are required by the Bureau
to facilitate arrangements which are to be made for the
removal of factories and plants to the interior out from a
study of the form and all it requests, the Bureau of Social
Affairs would appear to be collecting, under the cloak of
proposed removal, the complete working capacity of all Chinese
factories, their personnel and financial standing which are
still operating at the present time, so that either a more
efficient control can be exercised over them, or in the case of
emergency those factories and plants can be converted to
other uses, such as detailed under problems concerning
removal.

Pan Lien-pih

TRANSLATION
Regulations governing the removal of factories from
Shanghai laid down by the Shanghai Factories United
Removal Committee
.........
1. Chinese owned factories are entitled to the benefit
of removal.
2. The place to which factories are to be removed is
Wuchang. Removal to any other place can only be
sanctioned by the Supervisory Committee.
3. The government will issue monetary grants to the
factories to help pay the removal expenses, the
amount of these grants depending upon the nature
of the factories and their machines. The following
grants will be issued by the government after the
recommendation of the Supervisory Committee has
been approved. The Supervisory Committee has the
power to modify or reduce the grants.
(A) Grants for packing
(a) Grants will be issued for packing machines.
(b) Thirty-five cents will be issued for every
cubic foot of packing used.
(c) Grants for packing half completed and
finished goods, and tools with the
exception of pig iron and raw material
will be issued in accordance with (a) and (b).
(B) Grants for transportation
(a) A grant of $53.00 per ton of machinery,
materials, half completed and finished
goods, and tools transported to Wuchang
will be issued. A grant of $12 per ton
for transportation to Chinkiang will be
issued. Any money left after paying
transportation expenses should be returned
to the Committee.
pages.zh:
译文
上海工厂联合迁移委员会制定的关于从上海迁出工厂的规章
.........
1. 华人所有的工厂有权享受迁移资助。
2. 工厂迁往之地为武昌。迁往其他任何地方须经监理委员会批准方可准许。
3. 政府将向工厂发放金钱补助，以帮助支付迁移费用，补助金额视工厂性质及其机器设备而定。下列补助将在监理委员会的建议获批准后由政府发放。监理委员会有权修改或减少补助金额。
(A) 包装补助
(a) 将对机器的包装发放补助。
(b) 每使用一立方英尺的包装材料，发放三十五美分。
(c) 除生铁和原材料外，对半成品、成品及工具的包装补助，将依照(a)和(b)项的规定发放。
(B) 运输补助
(a) 对运往武昌的机器、材料、半成品、成品及工具，按每吨53.00美元的标准发放补助。对运往镇江的，按每吨12美元的标准发放补助。支付运输费用后的余款应退还给委员会。

worker who removes to Wuchang with his factory.
A grant of $30 for living expenses of the
worker for two months will be issued prior
to his leaving. If his factory resumes
operations within one month of the removal,
one half of the grant of $30 for his living
expenses should be returned by the owner of
the factory. No transportation grants will
be issued for staff employees and apprentices.

(C) Grants for construction
(a) After arrival at Wuchang, fifteen "fang"
of land will be allotted for each machine
and a grant of $875 will be issued for
construction. For foundries, more land
will be allotted and an additional grant
of 20% will be issued for construction.
(b) Land at Wuchang will be allotted free of
charge.
(c) The grants for construction will be refunded
within ten years with interest.

4. When the factories have been removed to Wuchang, they
will be engaged in manufacturing military equipment
during the emergency period. In peace time, the
government will guarantee to keep the factories in
sufficient work.

5. Transportation procedure
(A) An application in duplicate should be submitted
together with a covering letter indicating the
kind of goods, the factory turn out, the amount
of grant expected and the name of the place the
factory is to be removed to.
pages.zh:
- 2 -

(b) 对随工厂迁往武昌的每位熟练工人，发放20美元补助。在工人离开前，将预先发放30美元作为其两个月的生活费。如果工厂在迁移后一个月内恢复生产，工厂主应退还这30美元生活费补助的一半。职员和学徒不享受运输补助。

(C) 建设补助
(a) 抵达武昌后，每台机器分配十五“方”土地，并发放875美元的建设补助。对于铸造厂，将分配更多土地，并额外增加20%的建设补助。
(b) 武昌的土地将免费分配。
(c) 建设补助需在十年内连本带息偿还。

4. 工厂迁至武昌后，在紧急时期将从事军用装备制造。和平时期，政府保证为工厂提供充足的工作任务。

5. 运输程序
(A) 应提交一式两份的申请书，并附函说明货物种类、工厂产量、预期补助金额以及工厂拟迁往的地点名称。

pages.en:
- 3 -

The following points are to be noted in filling
in application forms :-
(a) -- (1) machines and tools;
(2) materials;
(3) half completed and finished goods
should be clearly specified.
(b) -- Applications should bear the detailed
addresses, telephone numbers, signatures
of the managers and chops of the factories.
(c) -- Measurements should be in the English
standard and weights in tons.
(B) When machines have been packed, a packing
application in septuplicate should be submitted
after which the Committee will detail
representatives to inspect the cases.
The following points are to be noted :-
(a) -- Machines, tools, materials, half completed
or finished products to be clearly specified.
(b) -- Each case to be numbered, measurements,
weights and contents to be stated.
(c) -- The factory will be responsible for any
inaccuracy in measurement and weight when
checked upon arrival at Hankow.
(d) -- The place where stocks are kept should be
clearly specified.
(e) -- Measurements to be in the English standard
and weights in tons.
(C) After cases have been inspected, an application
in nine copies for the customs should be submitted
to the Committee. Two of the copies will be
returned after being chopped by the Committee
to accompany the cases.
pages.zh:
- 3 -

填写申请表时需注意以下要点：
(a) -- (1) 机器和工具；
(2) 材料；
(3) 半成品和成品
应明确列明。
(b) -- 申请书应载明详细地址、电话号码、经理签名及工厂印章。
(c) -- 尺寸应采用英制标准，重量以吨为单位。
(B) 机器包装完毕后，应提交一式七份的包装申请，随后委员会将指派代表检查箱件。
需注意以下要点：
(a) -- 需明确列明机器、工具、材料、半成品或成品。
(b) -- 每个箱件需编号，并注明尺寸、重量和内容物。
(c) -- 工厂需对在汉口抵达时核查发现的尺寸和重量任何不准确之处负责。
(d) -- 应明确注明存货存放地点。
(e) -- 尺寸应采用英制标准，重量以吨为单位。
(C) 箱件检查完毕后，应向委员会提交一式九份的海关申请。其中两份经委员会盖章后退回，随箱件同行。

pages.en:
- 4 -

Points to be noted in filling in customs
applications :-
(a) -- Number of cases and measurements
should correspond with those on
packing applications.
(b) -- Chinese and English should be used.
(c) -- Applications should bear the signatures
of managers and chops of the factories.
(D) Photographs of 2" size in triplicate of
skilled workers who remove with their
factories to Wuchang should be affixed to
registration forms in triplicate issued by
the Committee. One of the forms will be
returned after being chopped.
(E) When the cases of machinery and products have
been loaded and before the departure of the
workers, an application in duplicate for
grants for transportation, packing and living
expenses of the workers may be submitted.
Receipts should be issued for the money.
Points to be noted in filling in
applications for grants :-
(a) -- Transportation fees, packing fees,
living and travelling expenses to be
separately specified.
(b) -- Applications to bear the signatures and
chops of the factories concerned.
(F) Before the departure of the steamer to Hankow,
an application for the issue of a pass for
steamer and a huchao should be submitted.
If the factory concerned is situated in Nantao
or Chapei, passes for men and vehicles can be
pages.zh:

填写海关申请时需注意以下要点：
(a) -- 箱件数量和尺寸应与包装申请上所列一致。
(b) -- 需使用中英文。
(c) -- 申请书应载有经理签名及工厂印章。
(D) 随工厂迁往武昌的熟练工人的2英寸照片一式三份，应粘贴在委员会签发的一式三份的登记表上。其中一份表格经盖章后退回。
(E) 当机器和产品箱件装船完毕，且在工人出发之前，可提交一式两份的申请，申领工人的运输、包装及生活费补助。领取款项时应出具收据。
填写补助申请时需注意以下要点：
(a) -- 运输费、包装费、生活费和旅费需分别列明。
(b) -- 申请书需加盖相关工厂的签名和印章。
(F) 在驶往汉口的轮船出发前，应提交申请，申领轮船通行证和护照（huchao）。如果相关工厂位于南市或闸北，人员和车辆通行证可在

pages.en:
- 5 -

obtained from this Committee after applications
for grants for the removal of the factory have
been submitted.

Points to be noted in filling in
applications for the issue of passes :-
(a) -- Applications should state the number
of passes and "huchao" required.
(b) -- Applications for the issue of passes
and "huchao" should be certified by
this Committee by the Trade Association
to which the factory making the
application belongs, or by a responsible
officer of the trade association.
(c) -- Passes to be issued should bear the
chops of the manager and of the factory.
When the passes are not required, they
should be returned immediately.
(d) -- Before the departures of steamers, a
report in duplicate on the departure
should be submitted to the Committee.
Letters of introduction to the branch
offices of this Committee at Soochow,
Chinkiang or at Hankow should be
applied for.
(e) -- If there are difficulties in finding
boats and vehicles, assistance of the
Committee can be applied for. The
number of boats and vehicles required
and the place where the stocks are kept
should be stated.

6. This Committee has established three branch offices
at the following places to assist the factories in
their removal :-
pages.zh:
- 5 -

提交工厂迁移补助申请后，从本委员会获取。

填写通行证签发申请时需注意以下要点：
(a) -- 申请书应注明所需通行证和“护照”的数量。
(b) -- 通行证和“护照”的签发申请，应由申请工厂所属的同业公会，或由该同业公会的负责官员证明，并经本委员会认证。
(c) -- 签发的通行证应加盖经理和工厂的印章。当不再需要通行证时，应立即归还。
(d) -- 在轮船出发前，应向委员会提交一式两份的出发报告。应申请开具致本委员会苏州、镇江或汉口办事处的介绍信。
(e) -- 如果在寻找船只和车辆方面遇到困难，可申请委员会协助。应注明所需船只和车辆的数量以及存货存放地点。

6. 本委员会已在以下地点设立三个办事处，以协助工厂迁移：

pages.en:
- 6 -

(A) Soochow office: Room No.140, Dah Tung Hotel,
Chong Men, Soochow, with Li
Sheh Ying in charge.
(B) Chinkiang office: Room 16, Dah Hwa Hotel,
Chinkiang, with King Liu-tua
and Chow Yu Zung in charge.
(C) Hankow Office : No. 12 Ming Po Li, Kiang Han
Road, Hankow, with Tse Ping
Yuan in charge.

7. If the machinery of a factory is located in war
areas, they can be packed and shipped. 60% of
the grants for packing, and transportation will
be issued if a guaranty is furnished by a shop
or a factory of good standing and the removal
has been certified by a member of this Committee.
N.B.
(a) -- All application forms can be obtained upon
application.
(b) -- With effect from September 11, one half of
the grants for the removal of raw materials
and finished products to Chinkiang will be
issued. A restriction will be placed on the
removal of finished products.
(c) -- Separate measures for the issue of grants
to chemical factories will be devised.
pages.zh:
- 6 -

(A) 苏州办事处：苏州崇门大同旅馆140号房间，由李协英（Li Sheh Ying，音译）负责。
(B) 镇江办事处：镇江大华旅馆16号房间，由King Liu-tua（音译）和Chow Yu Zung（音译）负责。
(C) 汉口办事处：汉口江汉路明波里12号，由Tse Ping Yuan（音译）负责。

7. 如果工厂的机器位于战区，可以进行包装和运输。如果由信誉良好的商号或工厂提供担保，且迁移事宜经本委员会成员认证，将发放60%的包装和运输补助。
注意：
(a) -- 所有申请表均可通过申请获取。
(b) -- 自9月11日起，将发放运往镇江的原材料和成品迁移补助的一半。对成品的迁移将实施限制。
(c) -- 将另行制定向化工厂发放补助的措施。

S.1, Special Branch.
September 16, 1937.

Shanghai Factories United Removal Committee - new body formed

A new body entitled the Shanghai Factories United Removal
Committee has recently been established by the Ministry of Industry
in Room 504, 33 Szechuen Road, for the purpose of dealing with any
application from local Chinese factory owners for the removal of
their factories to places of safety in the interior.

The Director of the committee is one Mr. Ling Chi-yoong
(林继庸) and the Chairman is one Mr. Yen Yao-chieu (顏梯秋).

Further details regarding this organization are not yet
available as the staff members of this office, particularly one
named Koo refused to supply this office with the necessary information
on the ground that the existence of this office in the Settlement
and its functioning had nothing to do with the Municipal Council or
Municipal Police.

Certified true copy.
G. I. C. M. Lou

上海工厂联合迁移委员会 - 新成立机构

工业部最近在四川路33号504室成立了一个名为“上海工厂联合迁移委员会”的新机构，旨在处理当地中国工厂主将其工厂迁往内地安全地区的任何申请。

该委员会主任为林继庸先生，主席为顏梯秋先生。

关于该组织的更多细节尚不可得，因为该办公室的工作人员，特别是一位姓顾（Koo）的人，拒绝向本处提供必要信息，理由是此办公室在租界的存在及其运作与工部局或警务处无关。

核证无误副本。
G. I. C. M. Lou

A new body entitled the Shanghai Factories United
Removal Committee has recently been established by the
Ministry of Industry in Room 504, 33 Szechuen Road, for the
purpose of dealing with any application from local Chinese
factory owners for the removal of their factories to places
of safety in the interior.

The Director of the committee is one Mr. Ling Chi-
yoong (林继庸) and the Chairman is one Mr. Yen Yao-chieu
(颜耀秋).

Further details regarding this organization are not
yet available as the staff members of this office, particularly
one named Koo refused to supply this office with the necessary
information on the ground that the existence of this office
in the Settlement and its functioning had nothing to do with
the Municipal Council or Municipal Police.

主题 上海工厂联合迁移委员会
- 新成立机构

由 刑事侦缉督察 Sih Tse-liang 制作 经由 C. Crawford 转呈

工业部最近在四川路33号504室成立了一个名为“上海工厂联合迁移委员会”的新机构，旨在处理当地中国工厂主将其工厂迁往内地安全地区的任何申请。

该委员会主任为林继庸先生，主席为颜耀秋先生。

关于该组织的更多细节尚不可得，因为该办公室的工作人员，特别是一位姓顾（Koo）的人，拒绝向本处提供必要信息，理由是此办公室在租界的存在及其运作与工部局或警务处无关。

（左侧批注：抄送 5 秘书。）
（左侧批注：D.B.R. 9月16日。）

Sih Tse liang
